final_third_entries_per_90.definition: The player's completed passes and carries that start outside the final third and end inside it, per 90 minutes.
final_third_entries_per_90.label: Final-third entries / 90

goals_per_90.definition: Goals scored by the player, scaled to 90 minutes.
goals_per_90.label: Goals / 90

high_turnovers_per_90.definition: Possessions the player won back within 40 m of the opponent's goal (interceptions, recoveries, won duels), per 90 minutes.
high_turnovers_per_90.label: High turnovers / 90

pass_completion_pct.definition: The player's completed passes divided by attempted passes.
pass_completion_pct.label: Pass completion

passes_per_90.definition: Passes attempted by the player, scaled to 90 minutes.
passes_per_90.label: Passes / 90

progressive_passes_per_90.definition: The player's completed passes from the halfway line onward that advance the ball 10 m or more toward goal, plus any pass into the penalty area, per 90 minutes.
progressive_passes_per_90.label: Progressive passes / 90

shots_per_90.definition: Shots taken by the player, scaled to 90 minutes.
shots_per_90.label: Shots / 90

xg_per_90.definition: Sum of the player's per-shot xG from the benchmark model (camera-observable features only), scaled to 90 minutes.
xg_per_90.label: xG / 90

model.coefficients_source: fitted on the bundled elite cohort with the benchmark feature set only
model.note: Both the reference cohort and the user's match are measured with this model and the same reduced feature set, so the xG below is a ranking quantity, not the app's headline xG.

population.label: StatsBomb elite cohort — player-matches
population.source: StatsBomb open data (https://github.com/statsbomb/open-data) — events bundled in data/statsbomb_corpus, match metadata from the upstream open-data match index.
